piezas.titulo: Grammar in context: Shopping and prices
texto: Sentence pattern for price questions and asking permission: 1) Asking the price: [Demonstrative] + «ราคาเท่าไหร่» + [ครับ/ค่ะ]. 2) Asking permission to look: «ขอดู» (to ask to see) + [Demonstrative] + «ได้ไหม» (is it possible?). Example: «ขอดูอันนั้นได้ไหมครับ». 3) Asking whether things are the same: [Subject] + «เท่ากันไหม» (are they the same in price/size?). The classifier always comes before the demonstratives «นี้» and «นั้น».

opciones.explicacion: Correct: «ขอดู» (to ask to see) + «อันนั้น» (that) + «ได้ไหม» (is it possible?).

opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: it asks whether they have the same price.
